description: UNC-Chapel Hill — strong OUT-OF-STATE applicant, RD (in-state/OOS contrast)
rationale: Pairs with 032 to lock the residency CONTRAST at one school. The same strong profile that is a TARGET in-state at UNC (~0.37) becomes a hard REACH out-of-state: UNC's official OOS rate is 9.3% vs 18.7% overall (oos÷overall = 0.50, applied via the per-school OOS data path), and OOS enrollment is legally capped at 18%. A strong OOS applicant lands ~0.07. Range [0.04, 0.15] asserts UNC-OOS is a single-digit-to-low-teens reach — NOT the ~37% an in-stater sees.
